raw_response: This figure presents a bar chart illustrating the “effect” values for various language models across different language families. The horizontal axis represents language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis is labeled with these language family names in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the “effect” value, ranging from approximately 0 to 30, with a linear scale. The axis is labeled “effect” and the tick labels are spaced approximately every 5 units. There are seven distinct data series represented by colored bars: mBERT-L2 (yellow), XLM-L2 (tan), mBERT-R2 (dark orange), XLM-R2 (brown), mBERT-B2 (purple), XLM-B2 (red), and mBERT-B1 (dark green). The mBERT-L2 bar reaches a maximum value of approximately 28, while the XLM-R2 bar reaches a maximum value of approximately 26. The bars are not sorted, and each bar is accompanied by error bars, indicating the standard error of the mean. The error bars are approximately 2 units in length.
